job.title: [Post] URGENT HIRING | SAP HYBRIS (SAP COMMERCE CLOUD) TECHNICAL LEAD We are hiring an experience…

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Technical Lead | Senior Java & Hybris Developer
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise-grade SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs and microservices, with hands-on PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes deployments and production support. Proven techno-functional consultant driving requirements analysis, user story creation and stakeholder alignment, leveraging AI-assisted development to accelerate delivery across global e-commerce channels.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP HYBRIS (SAP COMMERCE CLOUD) TECHNICAL LEAD
cover_en.hook: I am excited to bring my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to Bhaskar Mishra, where innovative e-commerce solutions drive market leadership. My recent work at Rockwell Automation and Shell delivering robust Hybris platforms aligns perfectly with the Technical Lead role.

bullets.label: Technical Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions using Java, Spring and Spring Boot, delivering high-performance product and catalog services for Rockwell Automation.

bullets.label: Integration Delivery
bullets.text: Built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines (Profisee, DataHub, Hotfolders) and integrated SAP ERP and MDM systems, ensuring seamless data flow across global channels.

bullets.label: Stakeholder Collaboration
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional capacity, gathering requirements, writing user stories and functional specs, and aligning international business and IT teams to meet e-commerce objectives.

bullets.label: Production & DevOps
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), leveraged Docker and Kubernetes, and provided production support that reduced incident resolution time.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: Bhaskar Mishra’s commitment to delivering cutting-edge SAP Commerce Cloud solutions resonates with my passion for building scalable, headless e-commerce platforms. I admire your focus on leveraging modern integration patterns and AI-assisted development to accelerate time-to-market. Joining your team would allow me to apply my deep Hybris expertise while contributing to innovative projects that shape the digital commerce landscape.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to lead SAP Commerce Cloud initiatives at Bhaskar Mishra, applying my proven Hybris expertise to drive innovative, high-performing e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m eager to discuss the Technical Lead role at Bhaskar Mishra and how my Hybris expertise can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP HYBRIS (SAP COMMERCE CLOUD) TECHNICAL LEAD
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Hybris Technical Lead position. With over five years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, OCC APIs, and complex PIM/ERP integrations. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and will be available from 16 December 2026. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for your team.
